tutorial.welcome.title: Welcome to your café!
tutorial.welcome.text: A small matcha café: you at the register, one barista at the bar, one table. Guests pay €5–50 depending on their order, plus tips. Wages, goods and rent are paid every hour – your money is at the top.
tutorial.upgrade.title: Upgrade the matcha station
tutorial.upgrade.text: Open the shop (blue cart) and bring the matcha station to level 2 – or tap the device in the café. Better equipment works faster, and from level 5 a new drink joins the menu.
tutorial.staff.title: Your team
tutorial.staff.text: Hire a waiter: they bring orders to the table (more satisfaction and tips) and take work off your barista. The staff panel shows wages per hour and day – you can fire anyone anytime.
tutorial.satisfaction.title: Happy guests
tutorial.satisfaction.text: The face shows satisfaction. Decor, good matcha, table service, short waits and cleanliness raise it – happy guests come more often and tip more.
tutorial.offline.title: Even while you’re away
tutorial.offline.text: Your café keeps running while the game is closed: up to {days}, for {pct} % of the time – with all guests and costs. A manager extends this; automatic reordering keeps the matcha coming.
tutorial.locations.title: The world is waiting
tutorial.locations.text: From café level {level} you can restart your café as a franchise, earn zen and open more branches – Kyoto, Tokyo, Seoul, New York, Bali.

tutorial.order.title: Order matcha
tutorial.order.text: Your matcha lasts about one day. Open supplies (box) and order a package – it arrives tomorrow morning. Later you can reorder automatically.
tutorial.table.title: More room
tutorial.table.text: With one table, hardly anyone fits in. Buy a second table via build (hammer).
tutorial.hours.title: Day, night and opening hours
tutorial.hours.text: One game hour lasts a minute. At night the café is closed and time fast-forwards. Tap the clock to set opening hours – staying open longer brings guests but costs wages.
tutorial.social.title: Social media
tutorial.social.text: Post up to three videos a day. Followers bring more guests for good, fresh videos a short boost – sometimes one goes viral.
